draft_metadata.filename_title: 微生物群落分配代谢途径提高天然产物产量
draft_metadata.classification_reason: 论文核心研究问题是设计并优化一个由大肠杆菌和酿酒酵母组成的合成微生物群落作为紫杉醇前体以及其他氧合萜类化合物的实际生产系统，研究路线围绕菌株构建、共培养稳定性、底物与中间体交换、启动子工程、氧化磷酸化敲除、限速步骤解除与发酵优化等典型细胞工厂工程问题展开，所用宿主为大肠杆菌 MG1655_ΔrecA_ΔendA_DE3 与酿酒酵母 BY4700/BY4719 实际工业底盘。依据为正文 Results、Discussion 与 Methods 部分（PDF 第 1–6 页）。
source_gaps: Supporting Information 全文未提供；Supplementary Figures 1–19 及 Supplementary Tables 1–4 的具体数据无法核对。
GC-MS 定量所用校准曲线细节以及多个单氧化紫杉烷的具体身份在 SI 中（Supplementary Fig. 16–18），主文未列出。
部分发酵重复数与误差棒显示受图像分辨率限制无法逐一精确读取，仅能依据正文文字判断。
13C 标记实验（Supplementary Fig. 5）以'在测试管中证实'的方式描述，未给出具体同位素丰度数值。
图注中的 41 h 与 1:2 等群落比例数据只在 Discussion 中给出，无法在 Figure 4 局部直接对应。

verified_claims.claim: 互惠共培养 TaxE4–TaxS4 在 120 h 产 33 mg/L 氧合紫杉烷，紫杉二烯氧合效率从 ~50% 提高至 ~75%（P < 0.01）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 3 页 Results 'Inactivating oxi­dative phos­phory­lation' 段；Figure 4c 图注
verified_claims.evidence: the titer of the oxygenated taxanes was further improved (33 mg/L in 120 h), and the percentage of the taxadiene oxygenated was significantly (P < 0.01) increased (up to 75%, Fig. 4c)

verified_claims.claim: 首次竞争型共培养（葡萄糖碳源）72 h 仅产生 2 mg/L 氧合紫杉烷
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 2 页 Results 'Co-culture design' 段；Figure 1b
verified_claims.evidence: The mixed culture produced 2 mg/L of oxygenated taxanes in 72 h (Fig. 1b)

verified_claims.claim: 50 g/L 乙醇完全抑制大肠杆菌生长与紫杉二烯生产
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 2 页 Results 'Co-culture design' 段；Figure 1e
verified_claims.evidence: ethanol, at the highest concentration observed (50 g/L, Fig. 1e), completely inhibited E. coli cell growth and taxadiene production (Supplementary Fig. 2)

verified_claims.claim: 酵母生长 + 补料优化后，氧合紫杉烷滴度提升约 3 倍至 16 mg/L（90 h）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 2 页 Results 'Optimization to improve taxadiene oxygenation' 段；Figure 3a
verified_claims.evidence: the oxygenated taxane titer was improved about threefold (16 mg/L in 90 h, Fig. 3a)

verified_claims.claim: TaxE4（ΔatpFH）试管产乙酸 5.0 ± 0.1 g/L，高于亲本 TaxE1 的 2.3 ± 0.2 g/L
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 3 页 Results 'Inactivating oxi­dative phos­phory­lation' 段；Figure 4b
verified_claims.evidence: this E. coli mutant (named TaxE4) produced up to 5.0 ± 0.1 g/L acetate in test tubes, whereas the parental strain (E. coli TaxE1) produced only 2.3 ± 0.2 g/L acetate

verified_claims.claim: TaxE7–TaxS8 共培养产 18 mg/L ferruginol，超过此前 10 mg/L 的文献最高值
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 4 页 Results 'Production of other oxygenated isoprenoids' 段；Figure 6b
verified_claims.evidence: the co-culture successfully produced 18 mg/L ferruginol (Fig. 6b), which exceeds the highest titer reported in the literature (10 mg/L by S. cerevisiae28)

verified_claims.claim: TaxE8–TaxS9 共培养产 30 mg/L nootkatol 与 0.8 mg/L nootkatone；引入 PpADHC3（TaxS10）后 nootkatone 提至 4 mg/L（5 倍）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 4–5 页 Results 'Production of other oxygenated isoprenoids' 段；Figure 6c
verified_claims.evidence: the co-culture produced 30 mg/L nootkatol and a small quantity of nootkatone (0.8 mg/L, Fig. 6c)… increased the nootkatone titer by a factor of 5 (4 mg/L, Fig. 6c)

verified_claims.claim: TAT 启动子由 TEFp 更换为 UASGPDp 后单乙酰化双氧合紫杉烷滴度由 0.6 mg/L 提至 1 mg/L
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 4 页 Results 'Co-culture to produce monoacetylated dioxygenated taxane' 段；Figure 5c
verified_claims.evidence: the change of promoter improved the titer from 0.6 mg/L to 1 mg/L (Fig. 5c)

verified_claims.claim: 互惠设计下接种比例约 40:1（酵母:大肠杆菌），41 h 自然平衡至 1:2
verified_claims.evidence: the inoculum ratio of yeast to E. coli was ~40:1… the ratio of yeast to E. coli was 1:2 at 41 h, Fig. 4b

verified_claims.claim: 木糖限制条件下，单乙酰化双氧合紫杉烷得率上升，木糖总消耗从 ~120 g/L 降至 80 g/L
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 4 页 Results；Figure 5c、Supplementary Fig. 6
verified_claims.evidence: reducing the xylose consumption (from ~120 g/L to 80 g/L, Fig. 5c and Supplementary Fig. 6)
